notes.title: We've added 15+ languages support in VR Training!
notes.content:
🌍✨ Global Upgrade: 16 Languages in Our VR Training Apps! 🌍✨

We're excited to announce our VR Training Applications now support 16 languages, making them more accessible than ever. Empower your team to unlock their full potential, no matter the language or location.

Languages added:
🇬🇧🇪🇸🇮🇹🇧🇩🇲🇾🇮🇳🇷🇺🇫🇷🇩🇪🇦🇪🇧🇷🇻🇳🇰🇷🇹🇷🇯🇵

Discover our diverse and language-rich VR world today and stay tuned for more exciting updates. Thank you for choosing us as your VR training partner! 🚀🌐

notes.title: pricing model changed to permanent purchase
notes.content:
Hi everyone! After multiple testing we are announcing a major pricing update - now you can purchase a permanent license in any store without subscription and have our VR training FOREVER!

We understand that our VR training is mainly used by professionals and they really want to have no recurring payments. 

Happy training!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42214245/e3ce8875d38ff660af5017384afae44c4767651d.png[/img]

notes.title: Pricing model was changed to a subscription
notes.content: The one-time purchase model was changed to a subscription model

notes.title: Subscription plan for all VR Training!
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends![/b]

We are excited to announce transferring of our applications to the subscription model instead of permanent licensing (pay less to use instead of pay more to buy) which makes all the training even cheaper!

For all who’ve helped our project and/or have bought our permanent license, we maintain the permanent subscription.

Thank you! For questions or collaboration contact us at support@gwpro.io

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42214245/eeb6bf5f6d4b7b5b3bac554c72a29366f5ab6bef.png[/img]
